title: WHO and UNICEF recommend starting breastfeeding within the first hour after birth
summary: The infant-feeding fact sheet says infants should be put to the breast within one hour of birth.
body: The 4 August 2026 infant and young child feeding fact sheet says WHO and UNICEF recommend that all infants initiate breastfeeding within one hour of birth. That first-hour step is separate from how long exclusive breastfeeding continues afterward. The sheet presents it as a recommendation for maternity care and families. It does not describe a medical emergency procedure, and it does not say a later start erases the value of milk that follows.
